identity.name: Audubon Golf & Country Club
identity.notes: Audubon Country Club (also referred to as Audubon) is a private, gated, master-planned golf community in North Naples, Collier County, FL 34110. Established 1989, it comprises approximately 400 single-family homes on 755 acres with extensive preserves and Audubon Cooperative Sanctuary certification. The master HOA, Audubon Country Club Foundation, Inc., manages common areas, roads, lakes, preserves, and architectural standards. The country club and its facilities (including an 18-hole Joe Lee golf course) are operated separately by Audubon Country Club Association, Inc. Club membership is mandatory at a minimum social level. Governed by recorded covenants (Official Records Book 6078, Page 688); architectural review required for exterior modifications.

fees.note: Recent real estate listings indicate annual master HOA fees around $6,075–$6,175 per plot (range reported; lower bound used). Exact current figures not publicly disclosed; verify via estoppel letter from management (FPMS).
Resale capital contribution of approximately $3,700, indexed from a $3,000 base, required at closing for resales.
Country Club membership is mandatory at a minimum social level; dues are separate from master HOA assessments. Amount not disclosed in source content.

Club facilities operated by Audubon Country Club Association, Inc.; membership mandatory (minimum social level)

Joe Lee–designed golf course, built in 1989, follows a natural coastal ridge and winds through estuaries, mangrove islands, and lakes. Ranked #28 among Florida's Top 50 Golf Courses and Top 10 Best New Golf Courses in Florida (Florida Golfer Magazine, 1990). Named World's Best Golf Community – Eastern U.S. (Links Premier Properties, 2018).
Privately owned and operated by its members, with roughly 350 member households.
Nearly 60% of the community's ~770 acres is preserved land; community is a Certified Audubon Cooperative Sanctuary awarded by Audubon International in 2008.
Estuaries, mangrove islands, and lakes throughout the community; homes offer golf course, lake, and preserve views.
Community golf course; condos offer spectacular golf and lake views.
